title: The X on the bulk bar shows Clear selection and leaves bulk mode
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919). The Admin role has 'Part Library & Inventory → View / Create & Edit / Delete'.
  • Inventory parts {Part-A}, {Part-B} and {Part-C} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-CLEAR-01 to -03) are active and tracked at {Location-A}, with quantity 5 each.
  • Their part numbers start with {Prefix-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-CLEAR).
custom_steps:
1. In the top bar click Parts, then click Inventory in the left menu.
  2. Type {Prefix-A} in the Search box.
  3. Click the ⋮ actions menu button in the toolbar, to the left of New Inventory Part.
  4. Click Deactivate parts.
  5. Click the {Part-A} row.
  6. Click the {Part-B} row.
  7. Hover over the X at the right end of the bar.
  8. Turn on the computer's screen reader (Windows: Narrator, Ctrl + Windows key + Enter; Mac: VoiceOver, Command + F5), press Tab until the X is focused, listen, then turn the screen reader off.
  9. Click the X.
  10. Click the ⋮ actions menu button.
  11. Press Escape to close the menu.
  12. Click the {Part-A} row.
  13. Click Cancel.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 7: Hovering the X shows "Clear selection".
  • Step 8: The screen reader reads the X as "Clear selection". If no screen reader can be used, write "screen reader label not checked by hand" in the result comment.
  • Step 9: Bulk mode ends: the dark bar and the checkbox column disappear, nothing is ticked, and the search and filter row is back directly under the tabs.
  • Step 10: The menu is back to normal: "Cycle count", "Deactivate parts", "Export".
  • Step 12: The row click opens Edit Inventory Part for {Part-A} (no tick), and {Part-A} and {Part-B} are still on the Active tab.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10815 (Story 2, Deactivate Parts in Bulk); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, v29 (14 Oct 2026 copy), S2-R9, S2-R9a, read 14 Oct 2026; design canvas board 4.2 (Mode on), board 4.3 (Two rows ticked), 13 Oct copy. Source-verified 14 October 2026; not yet build-verified (no Part Lifecycle QA build exists).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S2-R9: “An X button sits at the right end of the bar. Hovering it shows "Clear selection", which is also its screen reader label.”
  • S2-R9a: “The X leaves the mode, clears the selection and puts the toolbar back to its normal state.”
